item.title: Bridging the Gap Between PLECS and SPICE
item.description:
📝 PLECS Spice is finally here. PLECS Spice brings SPICE device-level simulation directly into PLECS. PLECS Spice can simulate hybrid systems containing both standard PLECS and SPICE circuits.
🔗 Read more: https://erickschulz.dev/posts/plecs-spice/

item.title: Alarm overload is undermining safety at sea as crews face thousands of alerts
item.description:
📝 Press release 20 January 2026 Alarm overload is undermining safety at sea as new research shows crews face tens of thousands of daily alerts Digital transformation Seafarer Advisory services Analysis of more than 40 million alarm-related events shows most alarms offer little operational value, disrupt rest and push crews toward risky workarounds. Effective Alarm Management in the Maritime Industry: Insights from 40 million vessel alarms builds on LR’s Effective Alarm Management in the Maritime Industry report (released in September 2024) by moving beyond diagnosis to demonstrate what can be achieved in practice. Duncan Duffy, LR’s Global Head of Technology, said: “Our research found that alarm systems, when poorly managed, have themselves become a safety risk.
🔗 Read more: https://www.lr.org/en/knowledge/press-room/press-listing/press-release/2026/alarm-overload-is-undermining-safety-at-sea-as-new-research-shows-crews-face-tens-of-thousands-of-daily-alerts/
